_README: Edit these values for each client, then run: python3 _build/build.py && python3 _build/qa.py. Values marked SAMPLE must be replaced before launch. Keep demo_mode true until real client details are in; it adds noindex to every page and the yellow demo banner. accent: brand colour #rrggbb used for buttons and highlights (the build stops if it is too dark to read). accent_alt: the second colour used for steel and metal details and the gradient (#rrggbb). logo: path to the client's logo, e.g. assets/img/client/logo.png (transparent PNG best); empty = built-in mark + name. services: remove any slug the client does not offer, then fix any sentences listed in _build/removed-service-mentions.txt. photos: the client's own job photos only (see _build/photos.py). intro: false turns the opening animation off; intro_scope 'all' plays it on whichever page a visitor lands on first, 'home' limits it to the home page. hero_fx: false turns off the fence line drawn behind the home hero. locate_service / locate_url: the free call-before-you-dig service for the client's province or state (Ontario One Call in Ontario, 811 in the US). estimator: see the _README inside it.
hours_note: Site visits and estimates by appointment

estimator._README: Instant fence estimate (/fence-estimate/). Set the client's real installed prices before launch. Everything runs in the visitor's browser; nothing is sent until they submit the form. materials: each fence material the client installs. per_ft = typical installed price per linear foot (CAD) at 6 ft high on flat ground, including posts set in concrete, rails, infill, standard hardware and clean-up. heights = the heights offered for that material (ids from 'heights'). walk_gate / double_gate = installed price of one 4 ft walk gate / one 10-12 ft double drive gate in that material. Remove a material the client doesn't install. heights: mult = price multiplier against the 6 ft price. terrain: mult applied to the fence (not gates or extras). removal_per_ft: old fence tear-out and disposal per foot (0 hides the option). addons: per_ft (charged on the whole length) or flat; 'materials' limits which materials show it; 'service' hides it when the client doesn't offer that service. length: the slider range in feet. range_pct = how far the low/high ends sit from the middle (12 = -12%/+12%). minimum_job = smallest job the client takes. round_to = rounding for displayed numbers.
